notes:
Account background: Silverpine builds a low-latency model-based bidder and reranker for programmatic ads. They ingest last-click+context and need inference in strict realtime for auction decisions. High throughput windowed bursts (peak 700-1,200 QPS), sustained baseline ~250 QPS. Primary ask: reduce per-request token cost while keeping p99 latency under 60ms for short prompts (<=128 tokens).

Key technical requirements / asks:
- Workloads: real-time bid scoring (primary), second-stage reranking, internal chat ops tool (secondary).
- Latency SLOs: p50 < 20ms, p90 < 35ms, p99 <= 60ms for 1-token incremental decodes; end-to-end (network + infer) budget 75ms.
- Throughput: handle bursts up to 1.2k QPS with graceful degradation.
- Cost target: aim to cap inference spend to <$100k/yr for initial prod slice (projected ARR tier).
- Model preferences: prefer open/quantizable models (7B-13B families) — experimenting with 4-bit/8-bit quantization profiles. Interested in Redwood-verified profiles for 4-bit group quant.
- Optimize interest: automated batching suggestions, prefix/KV caching for repeated context (bids often reuse ad and user context), and quantization guidance.

poc_plan: Phase 1 (3 days): Redwood-hosted perf harness against 3 model variants (fp16 baseline, 8-bit quant, 4-bit group quant). Measure p50/p90/p99, token/sec, GPU utilization. Phase 2 (2 weeks): Dedicated trial with autoscaling config + caching enabled; run production traffic replay (sanitized) to verify batching+caching impact. Deliverables: benchmark report, cost model, recommended instance sizes and quant profiles.
perf_requirements:
- p99 <= 60ms target for 1-2 token decodes.
- Throughput target: 1,200 QPS burst capable with <=10% error/timeout.
- Measure: tokens/sec, effective requests/sec, median GPU utilization, batching efficiency (avg batch size), cache hit ratio.
- Benchmark to include simulated network latency to match NA region average (10-25ms).
